audit_status.source_base: Greek Ephesians text tradition, draft aligned to public-domain comparison layer later
audit_status.review_note: Compact complete draft reviewed for cosmic blessing, election/adoption, mystery, summing up all things, Spirit seal/pledge, prayer for wisdom, fullness/body imagery.

verses.restored: Paul, apostle of Messiah Jesus through the will of the Divine, to the holy ones who are in Ephesus and trusting ones in Messiah Jesus:

familiar.text: Paul, an apostle of Jesus Christ by the will of God, to the saints which are at Ephesus, and to the faithful in Christ Jesus:

verses.restored: Grace to you and peace from Divine our Father and Lord Jesus Messiah.

familiar.text: Grace be to you, and peace, from God our Father, and from the Lord Jesus Christ.

verses.restored: Blessed is the Divine and Father of our Lord Jesus Messiah, the One blessing us in every spiritual blessing in the heavenlies in Messiah,

familiar.text: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, who hath blessed us with all spiritual blessings in heavenly places in Christ:

verses.restored: just as he chose us in him before the foundation of world, for us to be holy and blameless before him in love,

familiar.text: According as he hath chosen us in him before the foundation of the world, that we should be holy and without blame before him in love:

verses.restored: having marked us beforehand for adoption/placing-as-children through Jesus Messiah into himself, according to the good pleasure of his will,

familiar.text: Having predestinated us unto the adoption of children by Jesus Christ to himself, according to the good pleasure of his will,

verses.restored: into praise of glory of his grace, with which he graced us in the Beloved,

familiar.text: To the praise of the glory of his grace, wherein he hath made us accepted in the beloved.

verses.restored: in whom we have redemption/release through his blood, the release/forgiveness of trespasses, according to the riches of his grace,

familiar.text: In whom we have redemption through his blood, the forgiveness of sins, according to the riches of his grace;

verses.restored: which he caused to abound into us in all wisdom and insight,

familiar.text: Wherein he hath abounded toward us in all wisdom and prudence;

verses.restored: making known to us the mystery of his will, according to his good pleasure which he set forth in him,

familiar.text: Having made known unto us the mystery of his will, according to his good pleasure which he hath purposed in himself:

verses.restored: for stewardship/administration of the fullness of the seasons, to sum up/gather under one head all things in Messiah, things upon the heavens and things upon the earth, in him.

familiar.text: That in the dispensation of the fulness of times he might gather together in one all things in Christ, both which are in heaven, and which are on earth; even in him:

verses.restored: In him also we were allotted inheritance, having been marked beforehand according to the purpose of the One working all things according to the counsel of his will,

familiar.text: In whom also we have obtained an inheritance, being predestinated according to the purpose of him who worketh all things after the counsel of his own will:

verses.restored: so that we might be into praise of his glory, we who hoped beforehand in Messiah.

familiar.text: That we should be to the praise of his glory, who first trusted in Christ.

verses.restored: In him you also, having heard the word of truth, the good news of your salvation/healing, in whom also having trusted, were sealed with the holy Spirit of promise,

familiar.text: In whom ye also trusted, after that ye heard the word of truth, the gospel of your salvation: in whom also after that ye believed, ye were sealed with that holy Spirit of promise,

verses.restored: who is pledge/down payment of our inheritance, into redemption/release of the possession, into praise of his glory.

familiar.text: Which is the earnest of our inheritance until the redemption of the purchased possession, unto the praise of his glory.

verses.restored: Because of this, I also, having heard of your trust in the Lord Jesus and the love toward all the holy ones,

familiar.text: Wherefore I also, after I heard of your faith in the Lord Jesus, and love unto all the saints,

verses.restored: do not cease giving thanks for you, making remembrance in my prayers,

familiar.text: Cease not to give thanks for you, making mention of you in my prayers;

verses.restored: that the Divine of our Lord Jesus Messiah, the Father of glory, may give you Spirit of wisdom and unveiling in knowledge of him,

familiar.text: That the God of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Father of glory, may give unto you the spirit of wisdom and revelation in the knowledge of him:

verses.restored: the eyes of your heart having been illuminated, so that you may know what is the hope of his calling, what are the riches of glory of his inheritance in the holy ones,

familiar.text: The eyes of your understanding being enlightened; that ye may know what is the hope of his calling, and what the riches of the glory of his inheritance in the saints,

verses.restored: and what is the surpassing greatness of his power into us who trust, according to the working of the strength of his might,

familiar.text: And what is the exceeding greatness of his power to us-ward who believe, according to the working of his mighty power,

verses.restored: which he worked in Messiah, raising him from the dead and seating him at his right hand in the heavenlies,

familiar.text: Which he wrought in Christ, when he raised him from the dead, and set him at his own right hand in the heavenly places,

verses.restored: far above every ruler and authority and power and lordship and every name being named, not only in this age but also in the coming one.

familiar.text: Far above all principality, and power, and might, and dominion, and every name that is named, not only in this world, but also in that which is to come:

verses.restored: And he subjected all things under his feet and gave him as head over all things to the assembly,

familiar.text: And hath put all things under his feet, and gave him to be the head over all things to the church,

verses.restored: which is his body, the fullness of the One filling all things in all.

familiar.text: Which is his body, the fulness of him that filleth all in all.

translation_notes: Ephesians 1:3-14 is one long blessing in Greek; compact verse rendering preserves cascading movement.
Anakephalaiosasthai in 1:10 is rendered sum up/gather under one head to preserve cosmic recapitulation/headship range.
The assembly as body/fullness in 1:22-23 is cosmic and organic, not institutional control language.
